title: Sentinel-2 Cloud Mask
description: Cloud mask for the merged Copernicus Sentinel-2 mosaics delivered for NASA Disasters activations. Use it to tell cloud cover apart from real surface change in the same-day Sentinel-2 imagery. The mask is binary. Measured values: 1 = cloud, 0 = clear (cloud-free ground inside the scene footprint), and 999 = background fill outside the scene footprint. 999 is not a class: it is the rectangular padding around the rotated/irregular scene outline, so it is declared `nodata` and 0 is rendered transparent by the colormap rather than being masked, which keeps the clear-sky classification in the data while drawing only the clouds.
